entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery over %s aggregation is not supported
entries.rationale: every parser aggregation op is dispatched by the switch above this default arm (the eight per-bucket reducers plus quantile, topk/bottomk/limitk, limit_ratio and count_values), so no parseable query reaches it

guard: default of switch agg.Op over [case parser.TOPK, parser.BOTTOMK, parser.LIMITK; case parser.COUNT_VALUES; case parser.LIMIT_RATIO; case parser.SUM, parser.COUNT, parser.AVG, parser.MIN, parser.MAX, parser.STDDEV, parser.STDVAR, parser.GROUP, parser.QUANTILE; default]
